title: High-Capacity Complex Hydrogen Storage Materials and a Process of Releasing Hydrogen
abstract: Disclosed herein provide compositions and hydrogen release methods for a high-capacity complex hydrogen storage material. The hydrogen storage material is mainly composed of metal borohydride and NH 3 . The invention advantageously adopt ammonia, one cheap and easily supplied material with high hydrogen content (17.6 wt %), as one of the hydrogen source, offering a safe and efficient way to store hydrogen and release hydrogen. Furthermore, the hydrogen storage material can be further catalyzed by a transition metal catalyst to improve the dehydrogenation kinetics. With the addition of catalyst, 0.2-10 equiv. H 2  could be evolved at −100˜600° C., which might be applied on vehicles which are fueled by hybrid or fuel cell.

title: Boil-off gas recovery system of hydrogenation station
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrogenation stations, and discloses an evaporated gas recovery system of a hydrogenation station. The boil-off gas recovery system of the hydrogen filling station comprises a hydrogen storage tank, a hydrogen liquefying system, a liquid hydrogen gasifying system, a liquid hydrogen filling system, a hydrogen filling system and a hydrogen cache system, wherein the hydrogen storage tank comprises a liquid hydrogen storage space and a low-temperature gas phase space, the inlet end of the hydrogen liquefying system is respectively communicated with the liquid hydrogen storage space and the low-temperature gas phase space, the outlet end of the hydrogen liquefying system is respectively communicated with the liquid hydrogen filling system and the liquid hydrogen gasifying system, the outlet end of the liquid hydrogen gasifying system is communicated with the hydrogen filling system, the hydrogen filling system is communicated with the low-temperature gas phase space, the hydrogen cache system is connected in parallel on a pipeline communicated with the hydrogen filling system and the low-temperature gas phase space, and the hydrogen cache system is communicated with the. The boil-off gas recovery system of the hydrogen filling station can realize mixed filling, can fully recycle the hydrogen boil-off gas in the station, and realizes energy conservation and emission reduction.

title: Hydrogen storage material and its production method
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a new hydrogen storage material and its production method in which a hydrogen desorption temperature is low.  <P>SOLUTION: A first hydrogen storage material, which has nano-structurized and hydrocabonized boron nitride as a skeleton and desorbs hydrogen by heating, is obtained by crushing hexagonal boron nitride under a hydrocarbon gas atmosphere so that the long period crystal structure is minute. Further, a second hydrogen storage material, which is lower than the first hydrogen storage material in hydrogen desorption temperature and is depressed in generation of hydrocarbon, is obtained by crush mixing the first storage material and lithium hydride under Ar gas atmosphere.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: System and method for supplying hydrogen and hydrogen fuel cell system.
abstract: A system and a method for supplying hydrogen and a hydrogen fuel cell system are provided. The system for supplying hydrogen includes a hydrogen infusing unit and a hydrogen supply unit (100) which comprises a hydrogen storage unit (1), a hydrogen conveying unit (2) and a charging apparatus (3) connected with the hydrogen storage unit, wherein the charging apparatus (3) comprises a charging opening (31) matched with the hydrogen infusing unit which comprises an infusing apparatus matched with the charging opening (31). The external infusing apparatus uses the charging opening (31) to infuse hydrogen to the hydrogen storage container contained in the hydrogen storage unit, which avoids replacement of the hydrogen storage container (13) during the entire infusing process, and enables the intensively supplementing hydrogen period in a convenient and fast manner.

title: Parahydrogen adiabatic conversion refrigerating device
abstract: The utility model provides a parahydrogen adiabatic conversion refrigerating device. The refrigerating device mainly comprises a liquid hydrogen storing tank, a converter, a catalyst, a throttling hole, a hydrogen guiding pipe, a condensing heat exchanger, an emptying leading-out pipe and a valve, wherein the converter, the throttling hole, the hydrogen guiding pipe and the condensing heat exchanger are mounted at the top end of the inside of the liquid hydrogen storing tank; a parahydrogen conversion catalyst is contained in the converter; one end of the throttling hole is connected with the converter while the other end is connected with the hydrogen guiding pipe; two ends of the condensing heat exchanger are respectively connected with the hydrogen guiding pipe and the emptying leading-out pipe; and the emptying leading-out pipe extends out of the liquid hydrogen storing tank and is connected with the valve. According to the refrigerating device, the parahydrogen in the storing tank can be converted into orthohydrogen; and the hydrogen in the tank is liquefied partially by utilizing the converted refrigerating energy, so that the evaporation loss of the liquid hydrogen storage is reduced. The refrigerating device is free of requiring a moving component and extra power and is high in reliability, thereby being widely applied to the liquid hydrogen storage on the ground and in the space.

title: Production of hydrogen occlusion alloy powder and negative electrode for nickel-hydr0gen battery formed by using this powder
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To significantly improve the hydrogen storage rate of a hydrogen storage alloy powder, to improve the electrochemical characteristics when the powder is used for a battery, and to prevent the powder from deteriorating the battery characteristics for a long time. Disclosed is a method for producing a hydrogen storage alloy powder that enables storage, and a negative electrode for a Ni hydrogen battery using the powder. SOLUTION: The powder produced by using the gas atomization method is heat-treated, immersed in water or an alkali solution without being exposed to the atmosphere, and then subjected to surface treatment with an acid solution, thereby producing a hydrogen storage alloy powder. A method and a negative electrode for a nickel-metal hydride battery manufactured by wrapping a paste obtained by mixing a powder and a binder according to the present invention with a nickel mesh and then pressing the paste.

title: Rare earth-magnesium-nickel system heterogeneous hydrogen storage alloys used for nickel-hydrogen batteries and preparing method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses rare earth-magnesium-nickel system heterogeneous hydrogen storage alloys used for nickel-hydrogen batteries and a preparing method thereof. The alloys are characterized in that: the general structure formula of the alloys is Ln<a>Mg<b>Ni<x>Y<y>Z<z>, wherein the Ln is at least one element selected from rare earth elements; the Y is at least one element selected from a group comprising Co, Mn, Al, Cu, Nb, V, Fe, Zn, Ti, Cr, As, Ga, Mo, Sn, In, W, Si, B and P; the Z is at least one element selected from a group comprising Ag, Sr, Ge and Au; the a is less than 1 and not less than 0.5; the b is less than 0.5 and more than 0; the x is more than 2.5 and less than 4.5; the y is more than 0 and less than 2; the z is more than 0 and not more than 1; an AB5 phase accounts for 10-90%; an A2B7 phase accounts for 10-90%; and the ratio of other impurity phases is not more than 30%. B side elements are replaced by the Ag, the Sr, the Ge, the Au, and the like, alloy components and an annealing process are optimized, and the ratio of the AB5 phase to the A2B7 phase in the product is adjusted, thus increasing the discharge capacity of the hydrogen storage alloy, prolonging the cycle lifetime of the hydrogen storage alloy, and improving self-discharge and low-temperature properties.

title: Hydrogen storage alloy excellent in initial activity
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a hydrogen storage alloy having high hydrogen absorbing and releasing velocities, excellent in practical use, and having a superior initial activity. SOLUTION: This hydrogen storage alloy has a composition containing, by atom, 19-30% Ti, 0.5-10% Zr, 0.02-0.4% Hf, 30-42% Mn, 4-13% Cr, 7-17% V, 2-9% Ni, 0.1-3.5% La and/or Ce, and 1-10% oxygen and satisfying Ti(%)+Zr(%)+Hf(%)+Mn(%)+Cr(%)+V(%)+Ni(%)+(La and/or Ce) (%) + oxygen (%)+(inevitable impurities) (%)=100%. Moreover, this hydrogen storage alloy has a structure where hydrogenation and oxidation treatment product phases are dispersedly distributed in matrix phases of Ti-Mn alloy and the hydrogenation and oxidation treatment product phases are constituted essentially of oxides of La(Ce) and La(Ce)-Ni alloy and further has a structure where numerous cracks developing at the time of hydrogenation treatment are present and the hydrogenation and oxidation treatment product phases are exposed in the inner surface of the cracks.

title: Alkaline storage battery and manufacture of hydrogen storage alloy electrode for alkaline storage battery
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the cycle characteristic by using a hydrogen storage alloy as a negative electrode, said hydrogen storage alloy consisting of an intermetallic compound phase capable of occluding and releasing hydrogen reversibly and a pure metal phase or solid solution phase of a particular additive metal. CONSTITUTION:A hydrogen storage alloy, consisting of an intermetallic compound phase capable of occluding and releasing hydrogen reversibly and a pure metal phase or solid solution phase of at least one additive metal selected from among Cd, Sn, Bi, Pb which can be oxidized and reduced in an alkaline aqueous solution, is used as a negative electrode. In this case, the additive metal is oxidized or reduced in the alkaline aqueous solution and achieves bridging effect to bind the hydrogen storage alloy powder together and suppresses the falling-off of the alloy powder from the electrode supporter. The casted alloy has a eutectic structure and is a good electric conductor having a layer structure whose layers are arranged with a spacing of several microns. Thus, by using such a homogeneous hydrogen storage alloy as the negative electrode, the cycle characteristic of an alkaline storage battery can be improved.

title: Method for producing hydrogen storage alloy particles and sealed-type nickel-metal hydride storage battery using the same
abstract: A method for manufacturing hydrogen storage alloy particles comprises steps of obtaining a melt of the hydrogen storage alloy and pulverizing the hydrogen storage alloy by water atomizing process, whereby the melt is pulverized by contacting or colliding with high-speed jetting thereto to be dispersed in the form of solidified fine particles. By employing an aqueous solution of hypophosphorous acid or an alkali aqueous solution in place of water during the water atomizing process, or by etching the oxide films once formed on the surface of the hydrogen storage alloy particles with an aqueous solution of a strong acid, the thickness of the oxide film can be made thinner, and thus a high discharge capacity of a battery configured with a negative electrode comprising the alloy particles can be realized.

title: Vehicle-mounted hydrogen supply system frame for hydrogen fuel logistics vehicle
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the fuel cell car technique and specifically relates to a hydrogen fuel logistics vehicle carries hydrogen supply system frame. The hydrogen supply system comprises a frame main body, wherein the lower part of the frame main body is a power assembly installation space, the upper part of the frame main body is a hydrogen supply system installation space, and the hydrogen supply system installation space is integrally distributed in an L shape. The utility model has light weight, can greatly reduce the total weight of the vehicle-mounted hydrogen supply system, and meanwhile, the installation space of the hydrogen supply system is integrally distributed in an L shape, thus reducing the space required by the vehicle-mounted hydrogen supply system and effectively reducing the gravity center of the vehicle-mounted hydrogen supply system; in addition, simultaneously, the top of frame main part reserves on-vehicle hydrogen storage bottle installation position, if the continuation of journey of the longer mileage of whole car demand, installs the 4 th on-vehicle hydrogen storage bottle additional at the on-vehicle hydrogen storage bottle installation position at top, reaches four bottles and organizes hydrogen system hydrogen supply ability to effectively increase hydrogen fuel storage capacity, improve the continuation of journey mileage.

title: Hydrogen generating fuel container
abstract:
The present invention relates to a hydrogen generating fuel storage tank. It has an upper chamber and a lower chamber partitioned up and down by a movable partition, the lower chamber has a fuel supply port for introducing external hydrogen generating fuel into the lower chamber, and the introduced hydrogen generating fuel to the outside of the lower chamber. A tank body having a fuel discharge port for discharging, the upper chamber including a waste fuel inlet for introducing external waste fuel into the upper chamber, and a waste fuel outlet for discharging the introduced waste fuel from the upper chamber to the outside; It characterized in that it comprises a level detector for sensing the amount of hydrogen-producing fuel contained in the lower chamber of the tank body and outputs the information. 
     Hydrogen fuel storage tank of the present invention made as described above, the partition is installed in the storage tank according to the amount of hydrogen-producing fuel which is a hydrogen-containing compound that generates hydrogen gas through a chemical reaction and the partition wall outside the storage tank By installing a level detector that detects and outputs the position of the fuel cell, it is possible to always check the amount of hydrogen-generated fuel in the storage tank, and by forming a discharge volume of a predetermined volume to accommodate the hydrogen-generated fuel at the bottom of the storage tank. Even if there is no supply of hydrogen-generated fuel in the state where the partition is located at the lowest point, the fuel is configured to be able to supply some fuel, so that fuel supply is not interrupted during continuous operation.

title: Hydrogen-generating device, and power-generating system for generating electricity by using hydrogen generated in the hydrogen-generating device as fuel
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a device for generating hydrogen in a system using an internal combustion engine, and to further provide a system for generating electricity with the use of the generated hydrogen to prevent a secondary battery from decreasing the discharging capacity.  <P>SOLUTION: A hydrogen-generating device 7 comprises a proton-conductive solid electrolyte 75 having a pair of electrodes 76 and 77, and a voltage application means 2 and 17 for applying direct voltage to a pair of the electrodes. The power-generating system comprises the steps of: contacting one electrode 76 out of a pair of the electrodes in the hydrogen-generating device 7 with a gas exhausted from an internal combustion engine 1, in a state of having applied direct voltage to a pair of the electrodes to electrolyze moisture contained in the exhaust gas; thereby generating hydrogen from the other electrode 77 of a pair of the electrodes, which does not contact with the exhaust gas; storing hydrogen generated from the hydrogen-generating device 7 in a hydrogen storage means 9; and when the internal combustion engine 1 stops working, supplying the hydrogen stored in the hydrogen storage means 9 to a fuel cell 12 to make the fuel cell 12 generate electric energy and supply the electric energy to the secondary battery 2.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Method for heat treating metallic materials and apparatus therefor
abstract: The present invention presents a method and an apparatus for heat treating a metallic material by performing hydrogen absorption in or desorption from the metallic material. The method includes the steps of recovering the hydrogen gas released from a desorption step and recycling it to a hydrogen absorbing step. Hydrogen recovering can be performed either in a device containing a hydrogen absorbing alloy or in a second heat treating furnace containing the metallic material. Various controlling devices are used to regulate the process of heat treating and recovering of hydrogen gas.

title: Low-temperature plasma device and method for decomposing hydrogen sulfide
abstract: The invention relates to the field of plasma chemistry, and discloses a low-temperature plasma device and a method for decomposing hydrogen sulfide, wherein the device comprises: the structure comprises a first cavity (1), a second cavity (2), a third cavity (7), an inner electrode (3), an outer electrode (4) and a blocking medium (6), wherein the inner electrode (3) and the outer electrode (4) are solid electrodes, and the shapes of the inner electrode and the outer electrode are matched with each other to form an equal-diameter structure. title: RADAR ABSORBER
abstract: The radar absorber comprises alternate layers of highly conductive film (F) of combined fibre material without filling and layers of lower conductivity (intermediate layers 2) comprising either a core material, or part core material part fibre. The core material may be a plastic honeycomb or matrix or synthetic foam with a filler of balls or short fibres of glass, ceramic, carbon or plastic which may be filled or hollow. The dielectric properties may also be varied by conductive layering of the filling material of the honeycomb.

title: A process for generating electricity with a hydrogen fuel cell
abstract: The object of the invention is the coupling of a hydrogen fuel cell to an enzymatic process for the production of electricity and the transformation and sequestration of CO2. Gaseous CO2 emissions from processes such as hydrocarbon reforming are transformed into carbonate or bicarbonate ions and hydrogen ions by the enzymatic system in order to prevent their contribution to the greenhouse effect.      The hydrogen ions resulting from the enzymatic process are recovered and combined in order to supply the hydrogen fuel cell. Finally, water, a by-product of the oxidizing reaction of the hydrogen fuel cell, is recovered and recycled back into the aqueous enzymatic system.

title: Gasification of plastics
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To efficiently decompose plastics into hydrogen gas. SOLUTION: This is a gasification process by allowing plastics to react with water at a temperature over 200 deg.C. A compound that liberates a halogen on the reaction is used as a reaction catalyst. As a halogen compound to be used as the catalyst in this process, a chlorine-containing plastic, hydrochloric acid, hydrogen bromide, sodium fluoride, sodium chloride and other halides, are cited.

title: Process for preparing aromatic polyamides of high hydrolysis resistance with controlled water content of diamine
abstract: There is described a process for preparing aromatic polyamides of high hydrolysis resistance by reacting aromatic diamines in a conventional organic solvent and in the presence or absence of inorganic salts wherein the diamine, which has a water content of up to 25% by weight, is dissolved in the organic solvent, which may likewise contain water, and the solution is subjected to a vacuum distillation until the water content of the bottom product is <100 ppm and subsequently the inorganic salts if necessary and then the dicarbonyl dichloride are added in a conventional manner and the condensation reaction is performed and concluded in a conventional manner.

title: Brake disk
abstract: A disk brake assembly having a friction disk mounted on the hub of a motorcycle wheel, the friction disk having an inner hub and an outer ring interengaged by a plurality of equally spaced offset arms connecting the outer ring to the inner hub. The angle of each arm being such that the heat generated in the outer ring causes the outer end of the arms to expand in relation to the expansion of the outer ring and to contract on cooling to return the outer ring to its original position.

title: Home fuel cell boiler system having combustion catalysis device
abstract: The present invention relates to a domestic fuel cell boiler system having a catalytic combustor. This is the fuel cell stack 23 in the home fuel cell boiler system 3 in which fuel from the fuel supply unit 21 is supplied as hydrogen gas through the reformer 22 to generate electricity in the fuel cell stack 23. A catalyst combustor 31 receiving combustion gas discharged from the combustion gas and burning the catalyst by a catalytic reaction, and injecting the fuel supplied from the fuel supply part 21 to further burn the catalyst by the catalytic reaction when hot water is needed; A reaction heat exchanger (32) for transferring heat generated in the combustion process of the catalytic combustor (31) to the reformer (22) normally; And a hot water heat exchanger 33 for receiving hot water from the reaction heat heat exchanger 32 to generate hot water when necessary. abstract: Methods and compositions for decontaminating exposed surfaces or spaces which may be contaminated with chemical and biological warfare agents and the like are disclosed. The contaminants can be chemical warfare agents, industrial pollutants, pesticides, toxins and the like. For decontamination, a contaminated surface or space is contacted with an aerosol comprising a decontaminating agent, and subsequently or simultaneously, the decontaminated surface or space is contacted with an aerosol comprising a decontaminating agent antagonist. In particular, self-inactivating aerosols are disclosed.

title: Apparatus and method for operating a fuel cell system
abstract: The invention relates to a method for operating a fuel cell system (1) with a fuel (27), which fuel cell system (1) at least one high-temperature fuel cell (10) having at least one in a cathode chamber (12) arranged cathode (11), with at least one in a Anodes (13) arranged anode space (14) and with a between cathode space (12) and anode space (14) existing electrolyte (15), wherein in an anode gas cycle (20) from the anode space (14) of at least one high-temperature fuel cell (10) recycled Anode exhaust gas (25) is mixed with fuel (27) and supplied as anode gas (30) with at least one gas conveyor (50) to an anode gas heat exchanger (70) in which the anode gas (31) is thermostated, wherein further in at least one reforming unit (60, 61) in the anode gas circuit (20) of the fuel (27) is reformed. The at least one reforming unit (60, 61, 62, 63) is disposed in a hot circulation section (210) of the anode gas loop (20) in which an anode gas temperature (200) is above that required in the reforming unit (60, 61, 62, 63) Equilibrium temperature is reached and the at least one gas conveyor (50) in a cool circuit section (220) of the Anodengaskreislaufs (20) is arranged, in which an anode gas temperature (200) below that in the hot circuit section (210) is reached.

title: Composite membranes for olefin/paraffin separation
abstract: This invention presents a metal-doped zeolite membrane-based apparatus containing molecular sieving zeolite thin film on the seeded porous substrate. The metal-doped zeolite membrane exhibits high selectivity to olefin over paraffins. The membrane is synthesized by seed coating and secondary growth method, followed by metal doping and post treatment processes.

title: Wind electric plant with improved alternator field excitation
abstract: An improvement in a wind electric plant of the type disclosed in applicants' U.S. Pat. No. 4,059,771 and applicants' co-pending application Ser. No. 887,373, filed Mar. 16, 1978. The improvement comprises utilization of an exciter including an exciter armature and an associated permanent magnet exciter field to provide the excitation current for the field winding of a three-phase alternator. The use of permanent magnets in the exciter field, in lieu of conventional exciter field windings, eliminates the utilization of battery current as the source of excitation current for the field winding of a three-phase alternator. The improved wind electric power plant is utilized to supply A. C. power to hot water heater loads and/or auxiliary loads such as air conditioners, devices to manufacture hydrogen gas, and the like, which may be solar powered. The present invention also provides associated circuitry operable so that power can be supplied alternatively to either the hot water heater loads or to the auxiliary loads thereby maintaining a constant load on the wind electric power plant to ensure the quiet operation of that plant.

title: Method of playing a wagering game
abstract: A method of playing a wagering game 20 between a plurality of players includes dealing four-card hands from a standard 52 card deck to each player, including a player-banker. The cards have numerical values, ace equals one, face cards equal ten, and two through ten equal their respective face values. The players are afforded the opportunity to (a) draw one additional card, or (b) stand with the dealt cards. The object of the game 20 is to have three cards which total to one of ten, twenty, or thirty. The winning hand is then determined by either (a) the fourth card with the highest numerical value, or (b) the least significant digit of the total of the fourth and fifth cards with the highest numerical value. If neither player has three cards which total to one of ten, twenty, or thirty, then the hand is a push and no wager 500 is won by either player.

title: Compact furnace rear arrangement of 1000 MW ultra-supercritical unit
abstract: The utility model discloses a compact furnace rear arrangement of a 1000 MW ultra-supercritical unit. The arrangement comprises four electrostatic dust collectors longitudinally arranged into a row, front flues and rear flues of the electrostatic dust collectors, two absorption towers and a chimney between the two absorption towers, wherein the electrostatic dust collectors sequentially penetrate through the rear flues, induced draft fans are connected onto the absorption towers, the induced draft fans and booster fans are combined together, the induced draft fans, the booster fans and low-temperature economizers are jointly arranged below the rear flue, and the low-temperature economizers directly face outlets of the induced draft fans. The compact furnace rear arrangement has the benefits as follows: the arrangement is more compact, floor space can be effectively reduced, the use amount of steel is reduced, and the economic effects are obvious.

title: Gas stove
abstract: The invention provides a fuel gas kitchen range for supplying heat by using renewable energy resources, which uses fuel and a kitchen range to achieve the combustion between fuel and oxygen in the kitchen range, and is provided with a wind power direct current generator, an electrolysis water unit, a hydrogen storage unit and a combustion kitchen range, wherein the wind power direct current generator is driven by wind power to generate direct current; the electrolysis water unit generates hydrogen which is stored in the hydrogen storage unit; when used, the hydrogen is burnt in the combustion kitchen range so as to generate heat and achieve heat supply, thus the fuel gas kitchen range makes use of the low price of wind power to generate the hydrogen to achieve energy storage, can avoid the instability of the wind power, can satisfy the requirement on a great deal of instant heat supply in a kitchen, achieve energy resource recycling, and is suitable for citizens in windy areas and coastal area, and the like.

title: Composition of a material with porous structure, method for preparing the same and use of a composition
abstract: The present application relates to adsorbent materials exhibiting suitable for use in removing contaminating compounds in dynamic regime porous structures.  Obtaining these adsorbents is performed by forming slurries prepared in aqueous medium with mixtures of coal dust and powder of natural clay with particle size itemized below 20 micrometers 90%, these materials, once formed and dried, they undergo a only heat treatment in the presence of water vapor and carbon dioxide to obtain adsorbents with broad pore size distribution.  The structure of these materials has micropores corresponding to the activated carbon obtained during the activation of the carbon and of the same mode contains mainly mesopores corresponding clays used and macropores formed from the interparticle spaces.

title: Device for comprehensively utilizing tail gas of MOCVD (Metal-Organic Chemical Vapor Deposition) equipment
abstract: The invention provides a device for comprehensively utilizing tail gas of MOCVD (Metal-Organic Chemical Vapor Deposition) equipment. The tail gas of MOCVD enters a low-pressure buffer tank by virtue of a pipeline, and the low-pressure buffer tank is connected with a high-pressure buffer tank; the high-pressure buffer tank is connected to a precooling exchanger by virtue of a pipeline, and the lower end of the precooling exchanger is connected with a lower-temperature condenser by virtue of a pipeline; the lower part of the lower-temperature condenser is connected with a gas-liquid separator by virtue of a pipeline, the lower end of the gas-liquid separator is connected with a liquid ammonia storage tank by virtue of a liquid ammonia pump, and the top end of the gas-liquid separator is connected to a molecular sieve absorption column; the upper end of the molecular sieve absorption column is connected to a pressure-swing absorption column, and the pressure-swing absorption column is connected with a hydrogen storage tank by virtue of a pipeline. The device has a simple structure and can be used for effectively separating the tail gas of the MOCVD, liquid ammonia and hydrogen are recycled and can be directly applied to other industries, and nitrogen can be directly discharged. The rate of multipurpose utilization is high, and the purposes of safety and environmental friendliness are realized.

Method for triggering dependent spectra for data acquisition
abstract: Methods and systems are provided for triggering an information dependent mass spectrometry scan in real time. A mass spectrometry scan of a separating sample mixture is performed by a mass spectrometer at each time interval of a time period. The mass spectrometer receives the separating sample mixture from a separation device. It is determined at a certain time interval that a received mass spectrometry scan at the time interval and one or more preceding received mass spectrometry scans include two or more time-varying ion signals that represent two or more fragment ion transitions of a known compound. If a characteristic of the two or more time-varying ion signals meets a selection criterion, the mass spectrometer is instructed to perform a dependent mass spectrometry scan of the separating sample mixture for a precursor ion of the known compound at the time interval.

title: Electric string instrument
abstract: The guitar has a novel feedback arrangement for sustaining the sound generated from the strings and including a pickup associated with each string and a corresponding driver intercoupled with the pickup in a feedback loop that also includes a gain-controlled amplifier. The amplifiers are controlled in common from a variable control means. The pickups, drivers and associated electronics are all commonly mounted from the bridge. In an alternate embodiment of the invention there is provided an improved sustain technique that provides a more natural sustain characteristic, employing a parametric type of excitation. This embodiment may comprise a pickup, amplifier and tensioning member responsive to the output of the amplifier for sustaining string vibration by causing longitudinal string displacement by means of the tensioning member. In a similar embodiment the string tension may be held constant and the string length varied instead.

Fuel cell system
abstract: A fuel cell system comprises a hydrogen storage system for storing and releasing hydrogen, a fuel cell in fluid communication with the hydrogen storage system for receiving released hydrogen from the hydrogen storage system and for electrochemically reacting the hydrogen with an oxidant to produce electricity and an anode exhaust. A catalytic combustor is in fluid communication with the fuel cell for receiving the anode exhaust and for catalytically reacting the anode exhaust to produce an offgas having an elevated temperature that is greater than the temperature of the anode exhaust. The heat from the offgas is used to release the hydrogen from the hydrogen storage system.

title: Process for producing hydrocarbon oil, and synthesis reaction system
abstract: Disclosed is a method for producing a hydrocarbon oil, wherein a hydrocarbon oil is obtained from a gas that contains a carbon monoxide gas and a hydrogen gas by a Fischer-Tropsch synthesis reaction. The method for producing a hydrocarbon oil comprises: a hydrocarbon synthesis step in which the carbon monoxide gas and the hydrogen gas contained in the starting material gas are caused to react with each other in a slurry that fills a reaction container and contains catalyst particles, thereby synthesizing a hydrocarbon; a powdered particle removal step in which the slurry is drawn out from the upper part of a slurry bed within the reaction container and filtered, so that powdered particles that are formed by the powdering of the catalyst particles are captured and separated, thereby obtaining a liquid hydrocarbon; a catalyst particle capturing step in which the slurry is drawn out from a position lower than the upper part of the slurry bed and filtered, so that the catalyst particles are captured and separated, thereby obtaining a liquid hydrocarbon; and a catalyst particle returning step in which the catalyst particles captured in the catalyst particle capturing step are returned to the reaction container.

title: Anti-tip wheelchair
abstract: A manually-powered wheelchair that includes one or more features that enhance the overall maneuverability and stability of the wheelchair, such as centrally mounted drive-wheels and an anti-tip system. Other embodiments may include at least one of an adjustable anti-tip system that may be selectively located to several locations on the frame; a positive stop device attached to either the mounting bracket, frame, or the anti-tip system for limiting movement of the anti-tip system and the frame relative to each other; a resistance device attached to the frame and the anti-tip system for increasing resistance between the frame and the anti-tip system when the user leans backwards in the wheelchair; a wheel lock system engaging at least one of the drive wheels below the wheel's axis of rotation; and a tilt prevention device for selectively preventing any rotation of the wheelchair frame and anti-tip system relative to each other.

title: Beverage Container
abstract: A beverage container containing a hydrogen pouch is provided. The provided beverage container has a plastic container body having an injection port and filled with beverage inside; A plurality of perforated fins protruding from an upper surface of the container main body, and a sealing protrusion protruding from the lower surface of the sealing plate into which the plurality of perforated holes are perforated, And a guide protrusion having a first fixing protrusion and a second fixing protrusion protruded in a lower direction of the rim; A hydrogen pouch filled with hydrogen gas to be pierced by the piercing pin is installed in the inside of the hermetically sealed container, a first locking protrusion in which the first fixing protrusion of the guide protrusion is fixed, A plastic lid having a second locking protrusion for fixing the fixing protrusion; And a control unit.

title: Measuring apparatus and method
Semiconductor manufacturing apparatus
abstract: PURPOSE:To reduce impurity mixing into a film, and to provide a high quality thin film, by introducing another substance reacting with the imprity when forming the film under a reduced pressure condition. CONSTITUTION:When an Si thin film is formed with an optical CVD method using a raw material gas of Si2H6, hydrogen is introduced into the vacuum vessel 5 from a hydrogen gas system 11, and active hydrogen is then produced by irradiating the interior of the vacuum vessel 5, using a light source 3 of a hydrogen discharge lamp with such a wavelength that hydrogen molecules can absorb light to decompose into atoms. In this state, ArF excimer laser light from an optical source 1 which is shaped into wide planar light by an optical system 2, is introduced into the vicinity of the entire surface of a wafer, while Si2H6 gas is introduced from a raw material gas system 10. The Si2H6 gas absorbs the ArF excimer laser light and is decomposed, forming an Si thin film on the substrate 6. Since oxygen remaining in the vessel would couple with active hydrogen atoms and is exhaused out of the vessel 5 by means of a vacuum exhausting system 8, oxygen in the resulted film can be reduced to about 1/20.

title: Hydrogen fuel cell monofilm electrode test apparatus
abstract: The utility model discloses a kind of hydrogen fuel cell monofilm electrode test apparatus comprising air supply unit, heating unit, reaction member and power measurement unit；Reaction member includes the anode fixed plate stacked gradually, anode insulating layer, anode current collector plate, anode plate, cathode plate, cathode collector plate, cathode insulation layer and cathode fixed plate, and tested membrane electrode is clipped between anode plate and cathode plate；Air inlet and air outlet are designed in anode plate and cathode plate；Serpentine flow path slot, two connection air inlet and air outlet of serpentine flow path slot are provided in the one side that anode plate and cathode plate are contacted with membrane electrode；Two air inlets all pass through conduit and connect air supply unit.Air supply unit provides fuel gas, heating unit heats anode plate and cathode plate.Two kinds of gases enter substrate from two air inlets respectively, react under the catalysis of membrane electrode, generate electric current, power measurement unit detects the output power of reaction member, to obtain test result.

title: Water molecule low-voltage electrochemical separation device and water molecule low-voltage electrochemical separation method
abstract: The invention discloses a water molecule low-voltage electrochemical separation device and a water molecule low-voltage electrochemical separation method. Water molecule is separated to gas-state electrolyte quickly under the condition of specific voltage and current through an electrochemical reactor, then the gas-state electrolyte is separated to hydrogen and oxygen in low voltage environment through a low-voltage voltage-control centrifugal separator, the hydrogen and oxygen are mixed to store in a combustible gas storage tank, and the hydrogen and oxygen can be controlled to be output by a combustible gas output port to be used as fuel for combustion during use. The water molecule low-voltage electrochemical separation device is simple in structure, small in volume and low in power consumption, combustible hydrogen and comburent oxygen are generated with common water by utilizing electrochemical reaction and ultra-low voltage voltage-control centrifugal separation technology, the fuel is efficient gas-state fuel used after production and can not deflagrate in normal state, use is safe, any additive is not needed, product of produced hydrogen and oxygen after combustion only comprises water, any toxic substance can not be remained or released, and cleanliness and environment protection are realized really.

title: Self-rising type closestool cover
abstract: The utility model discloses a self-raised toilet seat cover, which comprises a seat colar and a cover. The seat colar and the cover are combined together through the base; iron sheets are provided on the cover to attract with magnets; position housings are symmetrically provided on both ends of the connecting base; a rotary shaft is installed inside the position housings to connect the seat colar and the cover; a torsion spring is sleeved on external diameter of one end of the rotary shaft; one end of the torsion spring is connected with an adjusting block; the adjusting blocks touch each other through springs and pins. Because the torsion springs and the adjusting blocks are added onto the rotary shaft inside the position housing, the force from the torsion spring can make the seat colar be ejected automatically from the toilet seat, so that the product can be maintained with the prior functions, and meanwhile, when the seat colar is pressed for operation, the seat colar can also be automatically ejected after humans leave. The utility model is characterized in low cost, high practicability, easy maintenance and etc, and is particularly applicable in such public places as hotels, restaurants, office buildings, stations, airports, exhibition centers and etc, as well as restrooms in ogranizations, units, enterprises and families.

title: Process for the treatment of crude oil using hydrogen in a special unit
abstract: Invention Patent: <B> "PROCESS FOR THE TREATMENT OF CRUDE OIL THAT USES HYDROGEN IN A SPECIAL UNIT" <D>. a process for the treatment of crude oil is provided to break the viscosity ("visbreak") and / or to benefit such oil using hydrogen gas. The process includes the steps of introducing hydrogen into a heated stream of crude oil or partially processed crude oil and mixing the introduced hydrogen with the oil to achieve intimate hydrogen dispersion to thereby improve viscosity breakdown ("visbreaking" ) and / or processing.

title: Integrated solid oxide fuel cell mechanization and method of using for transportation industry applications
abstract: A method of starting a solid oxide fuel cell system is disclosed. The method comprises pressurizing a main plenum to a first pressure. The main plenum comprises a first supply of fuel, blowers, and air control valves. The first supply of fuel and a first supply of air are directed to a preheated micro-reformer. A heated pre-reformate is created in the micro-reformer and discharged from the micro-reformer to a main reformer. The main reformer is preheated with the heated pre-reformate. A second supply of fuel and a second supply of air are introduced to the main reformer. A heated main reformate is created in the main reformer and directed to a waste energy recovery assembly. A cathode supply is heated in the waste energy recovery system and then directed to a solid oxide fuel cell stack in order to heat the solid oxide fuel cell stack. Methods of transitioning, operating, shutting down, and maintaining in standby mode are also disclosed. A solid oxide fuel cell mechanization for a transportation vehicle is also disclosed.

title: Fuel cell electric power generating plant
abstract: PURPOSE:To make self-supply of raw material gases possible by connecting current terminals of an anode and a cathode with water electrolysis apparatus, electrolyzing water by excess electric charge generated in a storing generated hydrogen and oxygen gases in respective containers, and supplying them to the reformer burners at the time of cell operation. title: Energy conversion system
abstract: This invention relates to a method and apparatus for converting energy to hydrogen gas using an electrolyzer and a metal alloy hydride tank for hydrogen storage, wherein a passive load matching device between the energy source and the electrolyzer maximizes hydrogen output, and the electrolyzer and the metal alloy hydride tank operate at mutually low pressure, near ambient, such that pressurization of the system is not required.

title: A nanowire heterostructure
abstract: The present invention provides a heterostructure for use as an electrode in a lithium ion battery as well as a method for synthesising the heterostructure.

title: PROCESS FOR DISCHARGE OF PRESSURE LIQUID NATURAL GAS CONTAINERS.
abstract: A process for discharging a plurality of containers (1, 2) having liquefied gas under pressure contained therein is disclosed. A gas is supplied to pressurize (10) a first container or group of containers to discharge the liquefied gas therefrom. The gas is then removed to displace from the first container or group of containers and is separated into a first stream of steam and into a second stream of steam. The first steam stream (52) is heated and passed to the first container or group of containers. The second steam stream is fed to a second container or group of containers to discharge the liquefied gas from them. Communication is cut between the first container or group of containers and the second container or group of containers, and the previous steps are repeated for all the containers in succession, with only the last container or group of containers emptying of liquid remaining at the pressure of the gas to displace, and all the containers being filled at the end of the process, except the last container or group of containers, with a lower pressure steam.

title: Acid ndfeb magnet recycling
abstract: recycling of ndfeb magnets in an acid medium, belonging to the sector of magnets or hard magnetic bodies of inorganic materials containing microparticles of micron-scale grain particles, refers to the recycling of nd-fe-b magnets in acid medium, more specifically by leaching these magnets with solutions of hydrochloric acid, nitric acid and selective precipitation of nd³ + ions such as neodymium oxalate and their subsequent conversion to neodymium oxide by heat treatment, the capture of hydrogen gas generated in the process and the copper used as magnet coating.

title: Quinazolinyl chalcone derivatives, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and bioactivity of anti-plant-virus compounds-quinazolinyl chalcone derivatives. The quinazolinyl chalcone derivatives are disclosed as the following general formula. Various substituted hypnones, p-hydroxybenzaldehyde, various substituted anthranilic acids, formamide, thionyl chloride, nitromethane, sodium hydroxide, potassium hydroxide and potassium carbonate used as raw materials are subjected to four steps to synthesize the quinazolinyl chalcone derivatives. The invention also discloses high inhibiting actions of the compounds q, u, w and the like on protecting inactivating and treating cucumber mosaic virus (CMV), tobacco mosaic virus (TMV), southern rice black-streaked dwarf virus (SRBSDV) and rice stripe virus (RSV). The compounds have higher anti-plant-virus activity and can be used for preparing anti-plant-virus pesticides.

title: Aluminum-based alloy for generation of hydrogen, method of production of such alloy and hydrogen gas generator
abstract:
FIELD: alloys for generation of hydrogen. 
     SUBSTANCE: alloy may be used in internal combustion engines working on hydrogen fuel and electric motor cars using hydrogen electrochemical generators. Aluminum-based alloy contains aluminum and dehydrated hydroxide of alkali metal up to 10% by weight or dehydrated hydroxide of alkali metal and copper up to 5%; total amount of these additives shall not exceed 10%. Method of production of such alloy includes placing the dehydrated hydroxide of alkali metal on crucible bottom with layer of aluminum laid over it; copper may be also added if necessary; melting is performed in induction furnace in vacuum at 0.2-0.5 atm and inert gas-shielded atmosphere. First hydroxide of alkali metal is molten and aluminum (and copper, if necessary) is molten in this melt at temperature of 660 C. Hydrogen gas generator includes reactor made in form of heat exchanger whose plates or tubes are filled with water. 
     EFFECT: low cost of process; increased productivity.

title: Improvements in or relating to an akylation process
abstract: An olefinic hydrocarbon fraction containing a mono-olefin of at least 7 carbon atoms, and preferentially oil-soluble, neutral, oxygen-containing organic compounds, including those having a carbonyl group, is contacted with an alkylatable compound, and a catalyst comprising liquid hydrogen fluoride, under alkylating conditions, alkylation products, and a liquid catalyst phase comprising said oxygen-containing compounds being separated from the reaction mixture.  C10-C15 fractions synthesized from carbon monoxide and hydrogen may be used to alkylate monocyclic aromatic hydrocarbons such as benzene and toluene and the alkylates sulphonated to produce detergents.  The catalyst phase may be treated to recover the oxygenated compounds and the catalyst recycled.  The alkylation temperature may be from about 50-250 DEG  F.  The amount of hydrogen fluoride may be 3-100 per cent or more by volume of the total reactants and should be sufficient to give two liquid phases. Alkylatable compounds which may be used include monocyclic aromatic hydrocarbons and substitution derivatives, e.g. benzene, toluene, xylene, ethylbenzene, n- and iso-propyl benzenes, ethyl toluenes, pseudocumene, butylbenzenes, chlorobenzene, phenol, cresols, anisol, phenetol, and benzoic acid, polycyclic compounds, e.g. naphthalene, anthracene, diphenyl, and naphthols, paraffins such as isobutane, isopentane, methylcyclopentane, and methylcyclohexane, and mixtures such as are produced by hydroforming of naphthas or solvent extraction of cracked gas oils.  The catalyst may contain minor amounts, such as 0.5-10 per cent by weight, of BF3, H2SO4, H3PO4, H3BO2F2, FSO3H, fluorophosphoric acids, SO2Cl2, ethane or toluene sulphonic acid, trifluoracetic acid or the like.  A C12 "Synthol" fraction may be introduced into a mixture of toluene and HF, the reactants being pre-dried, and the products passed to a stratifier. The lower catalyst layer may be passed to a recovery tower stripping gas being introduced if desired to separate HF and recover oxygenated compounds, viz. aldehydes and ketones.  The upper layer may be stripped of HF and fractionated to separate toluene from alkylate and unreacted olefins and paraffins.  The paraffins may be separated and worked up for use as detergents by conversion to alkyl halides and alkylation of aromatics followed by sulphonation or by conversion to alkanesulphonyl halides and thence to sulphonates.  Polyalkylates may be separated and recycled.  Comparative experiments in alkylation with HF, AlCl3, H2SO4 and solid phosphoric acid catalyst are given.

title: Hydrogen production catalyst
abstract: The purpose of present invention is to provide a hydrogen production catalyst to continuously decompose water for a long period of time to produce hydrogen by using only a small amount of thereof. Disclosed solving means is that the hydrogen production catalyst decomposes water to produce hydrogen by contacting with water under non-oxidative environment and the temperature of greater than 300 DEG C, and contains: a metal combination of Ni and one metal selected from the group consisting of free Pt, Pd and Cr, or a pair of metals selected from the combination of Cr and Pd; and an alkali capable of maintaining surface activity of the metal. By means of preparing said hydrogen production catalyst (3) in the reaction container (2) under non-oxidative environment and temperature of 300 DEG C-650 DEG C, the hydrogen production catalyst (3) contacts with water to decompose it to produce hydrogen.
